name: Slow Cooker Cheesy Beef Lasagna with Ricotta & Spinach

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add beef and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
680 g lean ground beef
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place spinach in a colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost. Using your hands, press out excess water, then place the spinach in a medium bowl along with ricotta and spices. Stir to combine the ricotta mixture and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (454 g) bag frozen chopped spinach
1 (425 g) pkg ricotta cheese
½ tsp onion powder
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the beef is done, add marinara sauce and water to the skillet. Stir to combine and remove from heat.

Cover the bottom of a 4-quart slow cooker insert with one quarter of the meat sauce. Top the sauce with 2 noodles (breaking to fit as needed) then spread with one quarter of the ricotta mixture. Finally, sprinkle with a ½-cup of cheese. Repeat three more times, finishing with 1 cup of cheese on top.
instructions.secondary_message:
8 no-boil lasagna noodles
2 ½ cups shredded cheese, Italian blend

instructions.primary_message: Cover and cook until noodles are tender, cheese is melted, and sides of lasagna start to pull away from the edges of the insert, about 5 hours on low.
When the lasagna is done, turn slow cooker off and allow it to sit for 15 minutes before serving. Enjoy!
